name: old-indicator-intraday-filters
study_type_note: Arms are fixed filters applied to the unchanged baseline's own paper trades. They do NOT have independent slots, cooldowns or parent-move state, so a filtered-out trade's slot is not re-used by another candidate. Results are descriptive of baseline trades, not strategy-level performance.

population.official: closed, not voided, minted in session, net R computable (backtesting.ts definitions)

fields.planned_target_r: (target - entry) / (entry - original stop), option premium, recorded at mint (signals.inputs)
fields.session_group: NSE_BSE for exchange NSE or BSE, MCX for MCX

arms.C: A AND B  (EXPLORATORY: both thresholds were chosen after viewing 5-22 Oct data)

reporting.official: net R under the official costs, per arm and for the skipped complement
reporting.quote_ledger: reported separately: simulated ask entry / bid exit from paper_execution_observations, fees only (statutory + brokerage, no spread), trades without OK quotes counted as unavailable
metrics: avg net R with 90% exchange-session cluster bootstrap
kept minus skipped avg R with 90% CI
largest winner share of gross profit
net R excluding the largest winner
verdict_rules: An arm whose avg net R is below zero is LOSS REDUCTION at best, never a profitable strategy.
No promotion because a number of sessions has elapsed; a change to live behaviour needs a separate decision with the evidence.
Minimum before any reading: 20 NSE_BSE exchange-sessions after activation; report earlier readings as interim only.
